title: Random But True Facts 16

status: APPROVED + SCHEDULED 2026-08-03 - publishes 22:30 Israel time (19:30 UTC) same day, video id Zu4n7UHvrDg, task dir storage/tasks/829e18d9-3fc0-446e-812f-621f829e314c/
outcome_note: Clean second data point on the completion-compulsion restructure - unlike ep13 it doesn't also change topic (stays animals), so if it retains better than ep12 the structure is the only variable that moved. TOOK TWO RENDERS. Render 1 problems, all caught in frame verification rather than after publishing: (a) the "fastest dog / 45mph" fact showed a dog AMBLING SLOWLY, footage that actively contradicted the claim; (b) the Chaser payoff - the single most important shot in the episode - was a wide frame dominated by an empty brick fire pit with the dog cropped into a corner; (c) the script said "Canadian authorities" for what was actually the Canadian Kennel Club, a breeders' registry not the government. Render 2 fixed all three (terms: dog running towards camera / border collie close up; source text now bans authorities-police-officials). LESSON: a term that probes well can still yield a weak cut, because each segment pulls up to 3 clips and cycles through them - probing proves the pool is on-topic, it does NOT prove every cut is well-composed. Verify the PAYOFF segment's actual frame every time. Also: the auto-generated caption independently reproduced the same attribution error twice ("Canadian police", then "Canada"), so metadata needs checking separately from the spoken script - it is generated by a different prompt.
